I’m really sorry… I don’t know how long I can keep my OC story going.
Right now, it’s getting harder and harder to continue updating.

Ki-chan’s story still doesn’t have an ending, and Sanshio’s story has only just begun. Everything just feels overwhelming.
There’s a real possibility that I might have to stop updating at any time.
With how fast AI is developing, I honestly feel powerless.
很抱歉，不知道我的 OC 故事還能堅持多久，目前來說，很難支撐更新……

主要是目前無業，收入也很低迷，現實生活中總是發生各種事情，讓我無法專心、也很難維持良好的心態去畫畫，訂閱數量也不多。小紀的故事還沒有大結局，三汐的故事也才剛開始，一切都變得很困難。

現在 AI 發展得太快了，我已經感到很無力了。
